correctness.rationale: Brownian time-change with generator ∂xx and mean-life conservation gives Q=rT=S^p/M(p), p=1/(2H), E Q=1, and stationary age survival density f(a)=Pr(Q>a). Two-sided Mellin moments imply L1 convergence (Q−1)/p→W=log S−Elog S. Fubini gives exact 2dTV=E|Q−1|, whence H dTV→E|W|/4; continuous log-exit law yields non-Gaussian f(1+py)→Pr(W>y). Independently recomputed first four exit moments and the special-function constant ≈0.160663948457; finite H checks only corroborate rate.
